an6.61:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane Migadāye.
an6.61:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāle sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi
an6.61:3.1: Katamo nu kho āvuso eko anto, katamo dutiyo anto, kiṃ majjhe, kā sibbanī' ti? 2.
an6.61:3.2: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:3.3: ‘phasso kho āvuso eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:3.4: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:3.5: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī' ti. 3.
an6.61:4.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:4.2: ‘atītaṃ kho āvuso eko anto, anāgataṃ dutiyo anto, paccuppannaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:4.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:4.4: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī' ti. 4.
an6.61:5.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:5.2: ‘sukhā āvuso vedanā eko anto, dukkhā vedanā dutiyo anto, adukkhamasukhā vedanā majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:5.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:5.4: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti . . . pe . . . diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī' ti. 5.
an6.61:6.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:6.2: ‘nāmaṃ kho āvuso eko anto, rūpaṃ dutiyo anto, viññāṇaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:6.4: diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī' ti. 6.
an6.61:7.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:7.2: ‘cha kho āvuso ajjhattikāni āyatanāni eko anto, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni dutiyo anto, viññāṇaṃ majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:7.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:7.4: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti . . . pe . . . diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī' ti. 7.
an6.61:8.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:8.2: ‘sakkāyo kho āvuso eko anto, sakkāyasamudayo dutiyo anto, sakkāyanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:8.3: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:8.4: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī' ti. 8.
an6.61:9.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.61:9.2: ‘vyākataṃ kho āvuso amhehi sabbeh'eva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.
an6.61:9.3: Āyāmāvuso yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamissāma, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocessāma.
an6.61:9.4: Yathā no Bhagavā vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā' ti.
an6.61:10.1: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho therā bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paccassosuṃ.
an6.61:10.2: Atha kho therā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
an6.61:10.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho therā bhikkhū yāvatako ahosi sabbeh'eva saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesuṃ.
an6.61:10.5: ‘Sabbesaṃ vo bhikkhave subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca yaṃ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane Metteyyapañhe:
an6.61:12.1: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an6.61:12.2: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho therā bhikkhū Bhagavato paccasosuṃ.
an6.61:12.4: ‘phasso kho bhikkhave eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbanī;
an6.61:12.5: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
an6.61:12.6: Ettāvatā kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hotī'
